summary: FEAT-002 meets the spec and design 4.1-4.4, 5.2 and 6.4. SynthConfig has all defaults including hier_dev_cortex 0.25 (OD1), and params stays TF-free. synth.py uses a fixed draw pattern, gathers only (no fine one-hot), the separable Gaussian with the s^2/12 term, the double remask, static bias interpolation and guarded stride-4 top_k normalisation, with tf.cond and an optional CPU-placed true branch. The post-process off paths are today's op order. labels and synth_override are keyword-only, a linear call without labels raises ValueError, and the deform labels are mapped by a 256-entry gather. The linear render matches transform_image's out(y)=in(M y) convention with M = T_mm^-1, as the design requires. impl-log records the run evidence: py38 compile/ast and TF-free import pass, 81 tf_gpu tests OK (OneHot multiset on==off with a negative control, trace once, override-false bit-equality, render consistency, CPU path, prob-0 graph identical), and both goldens report max |diff| 0. One NIT: the normalisation test tolerance is looser than the spec wording.
